[[File:Kiteplant.jpg|thumb|200px|A kite plant on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].]]
'''Kite plants''' were colorful flying plants native to [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. They stood, on average, over a meter in height, though taller kite plants were known to have grown.
